Fine Dining
May 2026 • Family
"Between the Da Lata fog and the warm golden lights on the window frame, Moon Dining not only serves a dinner, but also provides an experience so subtle that people remember emotions more than they remember food."

Evaluation of Details
Moon Dining brings an experience closer to the spirit of modern Fine Dining than traditional prayer. The most impressive thing about this dinner is not only the food, but also the way the restaurant combines space, light and landscape.

Space & Experience

9.5/10

Right from sitting at the table, the mild yellow lights, the large glass window frame overlooking the merchandise and the colour-changing sky of the Da Lata afternoon created a very unique atmosphere: romantic, mysterious and full of poetry.

The dining table is decorated with red roses, yellow lamps and dark tones of the interior create a warm feeling in the cold weather. This is the type of space where visitors want to sit longer to enjoy each meal instead of just eating.

“Moonlight Salad”

9/10

The salad is favorable thanks to bright colors, vivid presentation with fresh vegetables, edible flowers, tomatoes and peanut eggs.

Strong points:

Fresh ingredients.
Multiple structures.
The juice balances well between sour and fat.
Create a gentle feeling at the beginning of a meal.

This is the true spirit of Fine Dining: awaken the taste but do not make the guests full too soon.

The fish bread.

9/10

This is one of the most beautiful meals of dinner.

The smoky salmon slices are skillfully rolled on the background of bread and cheese cream, edible flower spots and soaked cucumbers. The dish gives an elegant feeling, the salmon taste stands out but does not override the rest of the ingredients.

A small dish but showing a little diligence in presentation and taste balance.

The fever of ice cream.

8.8/10

The food is moderate fat, cream fever covers good wheat fibers, combined with mushrooms creating a pleasant aroma.

A worthy point:

The wheat retains its level.
The fever is not too heavy.
The Parmesan section is directly obtained to increase taste depth.

This is a distinct "comfort food", easy to eat and suitable for the climate of Da Lata at night.

Smelling chicken fever.

9/10

Chicken ham is usually easy to dry, but the Moon Dining version shows the processing technique is pretty good.

Beautiful pressure surface.
The meat inside retains moisture.
The aromatic fever gives a mild sweet sour taste, helping to balance the white meat that is quite neutral.

The vegetables are well handled and contribute to the overall finish of the dish.

The vegetable soup.

6.5/10

This is the only thing that has not met expectations.

Although the form of presentation retains the delicacy, the taste has not created a corresponding emphasis with the rest.

Feel it:

The soup is safe.
The taste is not deep enough.
It has not created a warm or unexpected feeling as expected from a soup in the sky of Da Lata.

If the portion of the water is more condensed or there is a more distinct layer of flavor from roasted vegetables, herbs or deeper cellar techniques, the dish will be much more convincing.

Value of experience.

The most memorable thing of this dinner is not in a particular dish but in the overall experience. As the yellow light is reflected on the glass door, the outer dark blue of Da Lata is gradually turning into the night, each dish as if becoming part of the story rather than just a dish served on the table.
